init.title: ElioT Options
init.description: Update interval and battery estimate parameters

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch data from API (15-1440 minutes, default: 30)
data_description.battery_message_budget: Used for the battery estimate on devices without a coulomb counter (ElioT CLASSIC): remaining = 100 % − messages sent / this value. Default 80000 matches the VISIONQ.CZ portal.
data_description.battery_capacity_mah: Used for the battery estimate on devices with a coulomb counter (ElioT PRO). Default 2600 mAh (Saft LS 14500).
